notes.title: 《壶中日月 Timeless Teapot》Update Log V1.1.2
notes.notes:
Here are the main updates for version 1.1.2:  

**Main Content:**  
- Optimized the Celestial Workshop function (significantly reduced upgrade/ascension time, and now allows equipment upgrades/ascensions during battles).  
- Optimized the Forgotten River Collection function (added auto-purchase options for gold/red-quality items and a one-click "Buy All" button for current items).  
- Added auto-breakthrough (automatically breaks through to the highest achievable realm with 100% success rate).  
- Optimized character leveling (right-click to level up by 10/100/1000/max level).  
- Added one-click gem selling (gem auto-selling and equipment auto-selling are now separate options).  
- Improved the save file interface (manual and auto-saves are now in the same screen).  

**Bug Fixes:**  
- Fixed a bug where gems could be equipped.  
- Fixed a bug where excessively large numerical values caused data errors in later stages.  

**System Adjustments:**  
- Removed time restrictions for exiting stage battles.  
- Adjusted Yan Ke’s skill logic: increased single-instance damage but reduced activation frequency.  
- Added hover tooltips for Forgotten River Collection and Hero Recruitment buildings.  
- Reduced early-game monster difficulty.  
- Optimized in-game text descriptions.  

**Additional Notes:**  
If the game crashes or the process is forcibly closed during saving, the save file may become corrupted. A backup save folder (`saves_backup`) has been added to prevent cloud save loss. If the save is corrupted and prevents starting a new game, try the following:  
1. Enable Steam offline mode.  
2. Manually delete the corrupted save in the `saves` folder.  
3. Copy the backup save from `saves_backup` into the `saves` folder to attempt recovery.  

**Save File Location:**  
Press Win+R, type `AppData`, then navigate to:  
`\\\\LocalLow\\\\skyblack games\\\\Timeless Teapot\\\\userData\\\\saves`  

**Bug Reports & Feedback:**  
Join our Discord group: 1020655392  
Or email: 

skyblack7301@gmail.com

  

This game is independently developed in my spare time, and testing may be insufficient. If you encounter any bugs, please don’t hesitate to report them. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 《壶中日月 TimelessTeapot》Update LogV1.1.0
notes.notes:
**\[Core New Content]**  

1. **"Endless Trials" Challenge Mode**  

   - Consecutive battles against 5 bosses, with state inheritance (HP/cooldowns/disciple survival).  

   - Exclusive drops: **"Mystic Abyss"** and **"Crimson Glaze"** prefix equipment.  

   - Unlocked after reaching **500+ floors** (requires clearing one Secret Realm battle if above 500).  

   - If failed or completed, restarts from the beginning (infinite loop).  

2. **"Dao Arts System" Major Upgrade**  

   - Added **10 advanced Dao Arts** (Fire/Metal/Wood/Water/Earth attributes).  

     - **Fire Attribute**:  

       - *Celestial Flame (Gold)*: Burns armor, significantly reduces target defense.  

       - *Scorching Decay (Red)*: Inflicts continuous burn damage.  

     - **Metal Attribute**:  

       - *Golden Light Mantra (Gold)*: Dazzles enemies, reducing accuracy.  

       - *Metal Penetration Technique (Red)*: Weakens enemy accuracy based on attack ratio.  

     - **Wood Attribute**:  

       - *Rampant Growth (Gold)*: Entangles enemies, dealing AoE damage.  

       - *Divine Seed (Red)*: Boosts defense.  

     - **Water Attribute**:  

       - *Skywater Reflection (Red)*: Enhances stat conversion efficiency.  

       - *Frozen Soul (Gold)*: Reduces target’s max HP.  

     - **Earth Attribute**:  

       - *Shining Crystal (Gold)*: Suppresses enemy attack power.  

       - *Meteor Impact (Gold)*: Deals massive single-target damage.  

3. **"Ascension Realm" Breakthrough System**  

   - New realm unlocked, raising disciple level cap to **5020**.  

   - Secret Realm challenges expanded to **5000 floors**.  

   - Disciples can now ascend to the **Ascension Realm**.  

4. **Equipment System Expansion**  

   - New tiers: **"Realm Breaker"** and **"Finality"**.  

   - New sets: **"Mystic Abyss Legacy"** and **"Crimson Glaze Destiny"**.  

5. **Steam Achievements Integration**  

   - **24 new achievements** to unlock.  

---  

**\[Optimizations & Improvements]**  

1. **UI & Interaction**  

   - Added **resolution and fullscreen settings** in the options menu.  

   - Added **detailed Dao Arts damage UI** during combat (hover to view specifics).  

   - Added **Body Refinement progress display** (visible in character and training screens).  

   - Added **breakthrough success/failure visual effects**.  

   - Added **quick-access gear reforging** (directly from inventory).  

   - Added **equipment bonus details page** (click left-side button in gear menu).  

   - Added **equipped Dao Arts enhancement attributes** (e.g., "Arcane x3," "Burst x2").  

   - Added **sorting for formation gems** (by score/quality/level).  

   - Added **hover tooltips for world structures**.  

   - Added **early-game tutorial guidance**.  

   - Improved **character info display** (shows level and optimized realm visualization).  

   - Improved **Dao Arts equipping interface** (sorted by equipped disciples).  

   - Improved **hotkey logic** (ESC now closes the current menu first).  

   - Improved **collapsible quest log**.  

   - Increased **auto-battle timeout to 3 minutes**.  

   - Optimized **Body Refinement mechanics** (click disciples to train directly).  

   - Added **visual disciple training progress** (displayed in character screen).  

   - Enhanced **breakthrough-ready visual cues**.  

   - Fixed **Buff timer inconsistencies**.  

   - Fixed **infinite loop bug when exiting combat at the last moment**.  

2. **Art & Visuals**  

   - Updated **game loading screen**.  

   - Revamped **sect/faction scene art**.  

   - Redesigned **Dao Arts research interface**.  

   - Added **two new disciple gear icon sets**.  

   - Improved **numeric display for formation buffs in combat**.  

---  

**\[Other Adjustments]**  

- **Dungeon difficulty rebalance** (enemy survivability increased post-Lv150).  

- **Modified percentage-based skills** (e.g., "Searing Grasp," "Earth Sunder").  

- **Reduced healing Dao Arts multipliers**.  

- **Various text optimizations**.
